description: Deposit beta (repricing sensitivity) = change in deposit APY per 100bps change in a benchmark/market rate — the core credit-union/bank ALM & interest-rate-risk (IRR) model input. Pass the MCP field `product` using an exact underscore value such as `money_market`; do not send `product_category`, `mma`, or `money-market`. Derived from RateAPI's retained published deposit-rate history. SHORT-WINDOW / retention-bounded: full-cycle beta needs multi-year history (roadmap) — results ship with an explicit confidence/depth caveat. Deposits quote APY, never APR. Aggregate published rates only — never member/borrower data.

product.description: Required MCP product field. Use one exact underscore enum value; money market is `money_market`, never `mma` or `money-market`.

name: get_deposit_beta

benchmark_requested.description: The benchmark the caller asked deposit rates to be measured against, e.g. 'cd_top_quartile'.

benchmark_used.description: The benchmark actually used, which can differ from benchmark_requested when the requested one lacked data.

confidence.description: Qualitative reliability of the beta estimate — 'low' when the history window is short relative to a full rate cycle.

data_source.description: Internal backing store that served this query ('clickhouse'); operational detail, not something to report to the user.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

group_by.description: How results are grouped, e.g. 'cu' for one segment per credit union.

history_depth_days.description: Days of retained rate history available for this calculation. 0 means no usable history, so every beta is null.

note.description: Methodology caveat explaining that this is a short-window beta from retained published history, not a full-cycle beta.

peer.description: Distribution of beta across the peer group.

max_beta.description: Highest deposit beta among peers, as a ratio. Null when too little history exists.

median_beta.description: Median deposit beta among peers, as a ratio. Null when too little history exists.

min_beta.description: Lowest deposit beta among peers, as a ratio (0.3 = deposit rates moved 30% as much as the benchmark). Null when too little history exists to compute it.

product.description: Deposit product the beta was computed for, e.g. 'savings' or 'cd'.

segments.description: One beta result per group. An empty array means the retained history was too shallow to compute any beta, not that beta is zero.

state.description: Two-letter state code the analysis was scoped to. Null means nationwide.

term_months.description: Certificate term in months the analysis was scoped to. Null for non-term products.

window.description: Lookback period used for the comparison, expressed as a short duration string such as '4w', '90d', or '180d'.
